name: language-study/backend
description: Language Study Laravel API and admin backend

post-install-cmd: if [ -f config/filament.php ]; then printf '\033[32m%s\033[0m\n' 'Filament configuration already exists.'; else printf '\033[31m%s\033[0m\n' 'Publishing Filament configuration...'; php artisan vendor:publish --tag=filament-config --no-interaction; fi

if [ -f config/filament-shield.php ]; then printf '\033[32m%s\033[0m\n' 'Filament Shield configuration already exists.'; else printf '\033[31m%s\033[0m\n' 'Publishing Filament Shield configuration...'; php artisan vendor:publish --tag=filament-shield-config --no-interaction; fi

if [ -f config/livewire.php ]; then printf '\033[32m%s\033[0m\n' 'Livewire configuration already exists.'; else printf '\033[31m%s\033[0m\n' 'Publishing Livewire configuration...'; php artisan vendor:publish --tag=livewire:config --no-interaction; fi
post-update-cmd: if [ -f config/filament.php ]; then printf '\033[32m%s\033[0m\n' 'Filament configuration already exists.'; else printf '\033[31m%s\033[0m\n' 'Publishing Filament configuration...'; php artisan vendor:publish --tag=filament-config --no-interaction; fi

if [ -f config/filament-shield.php ]; then printf '\033[32m%s\033[0m\n' 'Filament Shield configuration already exists.'; else printf '\033[31m%s\033[0m\n' 'Publishing Filament Shield configuration...'; php artisan vendor:publish --tag=filament-shield-config --no-interaction; fi

if [ -f config/livewire.php ]; then printf '\033[32m%s\033[0m\n' 'Livewire configuration already exists.'; else printf '\033[31m%s\033[0m\n' 'Publishing Livewire configuration...'; php artisan vendor:publish --tag=livewire:config --no-interaction; fi
scripts.phpcs:check: phpcs --standard=phpcs.xml app routes config database tests
scripts.phpcs:fix: phpcbf --standard=phpcs.xml app routes config database tests
scripts.phpmd:production: php -d error_reporting=E_ALL vendor/bin/phpmd app,routes,config,database,tests text phpmd.xml --ignore-errors-on-exit --ignore-violations-on-exit
